title: service-storage S3 adapter: presigned PUT URLs bake in the CRC32 of an empty body, so a store that enforces it refuses every presigned upload
body:
Found while landing objectstack-ai/cloud#2533 (the attachments bucket CORS). Filed by the `repo:cloud` seat as an out-of-scope finding. The side observation came from the maintainer's reading in cloud#2533.

## Reading

- **Measured on hosted staging (R2), 2026-10-01.** The presigned PUT URL the S3 adapter hands the browser carries `x-amz-sdk-checksum-algorithm=CRC32&x-amz-checksum-crc32=AAAAAA==`. `AAAAAA==` is the CRC32 of an **empty** body, computed at presign time, before any bytes exist. R2 accepted a 98-byte PUT anyway, so R2 does not enforce it today.
- **Code, `origin/main`.**
  - `packages/services/service-storage/src/s3-storage-adapter.ts:233-242` builds the `S3Client` with `region` / `endpoint` / `forcePathStyle` / `credentials` only. It sets no `requestChecksumCalculation`.
  - `getPresignedUpload` (`:465-487`) presigns a `PutObjectCommand` with no body.
  - The lockfile resolves `@aws-sdk/client-s3` and `@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner` at `3.1090.0`. Since the SDK's flexible-checksum default (`WHEN_SUPPORTED`), that is what puts the empty-body checksum into the signed query.

## Why it matters

- The adapter is the framework's generic S3 door: AWS S3, MinIO, R2 and others. **NOT MEASURED:** whether AWS S3 or MinIO enforce a query-signed `x-amz-checksum-crc32` against the uploaded body. If one does, every presigned browser upload to that store fails with a checksum mismatch, while server-side `upload()` keeps working. That is the same "presign 200, upload never lands" shape cloud#2533 just had, with a different cause.
- Hosted cloud runs on R2, so cloud is not affected today. Self-hosted deployments on other S3 stores may be.

## Fix sketch (not measured)

- Set `requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED'` (and, symmetrically, `responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED'`) in the adapter's `S3Client` options, so presigned PUTs carry no body checksum.
- A unit test that presigns an upload and asserts the URL has no `x-amz-checksum-*` / `x-amz-sdk-checksum-algorithm` parameter. It is offline, with fake credentials and a fixed endpoint.

## Acceptance

- The test above, red before and green after.
- Optional and live: a presigned PUT of a non-empty body to an enforcing store (MinIO in a test container, if the repo has a pattern for that) returns 200.

## 查重词

`presigned PUT checksum CRC32` · `x-amz-checksum-crc32 AAAAAA==` · `requestChecksumCalculation WHEN_REQUIRED` · `s3-storage-adapter presign checksum mismatch`
